properties.name: prior_career_dm
properties.source_quote: You suffer a DM–2 to qualification rolls for each previous career you have entered.

properties.name: max_terms
properties.source_quote: The Referee may want to change the maximum number of terms spent in character creation from 7 to something else.

properties.name: retirement_terms
properties.source_quote: A character who has served 5 or more terms in a single service receives a yearly retirement pension, even if he or she later becomes an adventurer.

properties.name: survival_natural_failure
properties.source_quote: A natural 2 is always a failure.
